- \(A\) (probability \(1/3\)): \(( \min(a+1,2), b )\)
- \(B\) (probability \(1/3\)): \(( a, \min(b+1,2) )\)
- \(C\) (probability \(1/3\)): failure (probability 0).

\[
\begin{aligned}
f(2,1) &= \tfrac13 f(2,1) + \tfrac13 \cdot 1 \;\Rightarrow\; f(2,1) = \tfrac12,\\
f(2,0) &= \tfrac13 f(2,0) + \tfrac13 f(2,1) \;\Rightarrow\; f(2,0) = \tfrac14,\\
f(1,1) &= \tfrac13 f(2,1) + \tfrac13 f(1,2) = \tfrac13 \cdot \tfrac12 + \tfrac13 \cdot \tfrac12 = \tfrac13,\\
f(1,0) &= \tfrac13 f(2,0) + \tfrac13 f(1,1) = \tfrac13\cdot\tfrac14 + \tfrac13\cdot\tfrac13 = \tfrac7{36},\\
f(0,0) &= \tfrac13 f(1,0) + \tfrac13 f(0,1) = \tfrac23 \cdot \tfrac7{36} = \tfrac{7}{54}.
\end{aligned}
\]

The probability is \(\frac{7}{54}\), with \(m=7\), \(n=54\). Then \(100m+n = 700+54 = 754\).
